display.title: Purim Songs with Graggers
display.summary_short: A Purim sing-along from Uncle Yossi's show: everyone spins their graggers to 'Chag Purim', followed by a second Purim song from a guest singer.
display.summary_long: A short musical clip from the Purim broadcast of Tzivos Hashem on the Air. It opens in the middle of the sing-along of 'Chag Purim', with Uncle Yossi calling on all the listeners to spin their graggers together at the words 'rash, rash, rash'. Because everyone did so well, he treats them to another song, and a guest singer in Studio 604 sings a lively song in honor of Purim. The clip is almost entirely music, so the automatic transcript holds only Uncle Yossi's few words between the songs. It is a cheerful way for young children to feel the simchah of Purim, when it is a mitzvah to be happy.

date.note: Cut from episode 369, dated 21 March 1989 (Purim) in its filename; the songs were also used in earlier Purim shows.
